summary: This 3D mini game was developed to address the challenge of creating a game where the player could tweak in-game parameters to tailor the difficulty of it. We developed a game that has a menu where the player can set different aspects of the mission. The game includes the final stage of the Apollo 11 mission, where the player must try and land the Lunar Module on the surface of the moon using their thruster and pitch, yaw and roll controls. The player must use their limited control and thruster time to minimize the negative vertical speed of the Lunar Module just before touchdown.
details: The game engine Blitz3D was used to develop the game. All assets were either hand-made or were taken from free-use sources. The game simulates basic gravitational pull and a counteracting force.
